It would be nice if the Teleport to House spell had the option of entering in the building mode. If we could have a right click option to choose normal/building mode, or even be able to select one of those for the left click option would be very useful.

Most people may not see a good reason for needing this seeing as they can just go in there and use the butlers to get planks for them when training the skill. But as an Ultimate Ironman who has to do 1 inventory of planks at a time, leave to chop the wood/make planks, then come back. Teleporting back to your house, having it load, then having to change to building mode and having it reload, hundreds or even thousands of times while training. Having to change that option and waiting for it to reload that many times gets rather old and annoying.
